lessons: The cause was a codex provider outage (503 on the Responses WebSocket), not the ticket. The work itself succeeded: 112 files, 896 insertions, no deletions, and integration, lint and format checks passed. Retry at the same capability once codex recovers.

Every attempt starts from the merge base, so redo the full job: run `uv run clutch meta refresh` on exactly the 112 files in `## Scope fence`, then set each `purpose` with a throwaway script that is not committed, following the ticket's purpose rule.

Purpose rule (from the ticket): for .py files, use the first line of the module docstring, else the file stem with `_` and `-` replaced by spaces. Cut it to at most 120 characters. Never hand-edit `relates`, `owner`, `kind`, `verified` or `hash`.

Before committing, run every `## Verification` command (`clutch meta check` and `ruff format --check` on the 112 paths, then `./dev.py test`). Confirm `git diff --name-only` equals the fence and each file differs from base only by its block.
Commit right after verification passes so the work lands before the agent's final message, which is where the last attempt hit the outage.
